verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer guide documents registering an app and creating an auth credential, so the product does issue its own API credentials. Nothing in the evidence shows those credentials can be scoped or restricted to least privilege for an agent. The 'custom roles and permissions' admin feature covers user administration, an adjacent control that earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented per-app/per-credential permission scopes, least-privilege or agent-specific credential guidance, revocation/expiry controls, and independent corroboration.
